greeting: Good morning, Zae. Last Fun Day at Sea on Paradise: rest, decks, Express Debark setup before 1 PM, and Tampa tomorrow morning.

calendar.note: Sea day 2 toward Tampa; set Express Debark today; return bus morning tomorrow

events.title: Morning Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Tyrosine, L-Theanine, two Omega soft gels, Vitamin D3 + K2, and B-Complex if you packed them.
Fun Day at Sea en route to Tampa. Last full day aboard before Thursday arrival ~8:00 AM.
Express Debark setup in the Hub: My Planner → last day → Schedule Debarkation → Express Debarkation → earliest slot. Keep all bags in the cabin overnight (do not put them in the hallway).
Afternoon Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Tyrosine and one or two Omega soft gels.
Night Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Theanine and three Neuro-Mag capsules. Creatine 5g any time today. Pack so you can vacate the cabin by about 8:30 AM tomorrow.

projectMove.title: Sea day for you; Arena Phase 30 waiting on Grok Build balance
projectMove.body: Enjoy the last day at sea. Ashore, Arena Phase 29 finished clean, and Phase 30 (progression, XP, achievements, cosmetics) hit a Grok Build usage wall (HTTP 402) mid-run yesterday afternoon. Testarossa keeps probing and will resume the moment balance returns; a top-up restarts the conveyor sooner than waiting on the next weekly reset.

tip.title: Express Debark today, bags stay in the cabin
tip.body: In the Hub, schedule Express Debarkation for the earliest slot before 1 PM ship time. Leave luggage in the cabin overnight rather than in the hallway, plan to be out by about 8:30 AM Thursday, then Uber to Hart North Platform (1315 N Marion St) by about 10:30 for the 11:10 Greyhound to Tallahassee.

extras.weatherNote: Open Gulf on the return track toward Tampa. Favor decks and rest; tomorrow is early debark and the bus home.

surprise.title: While you were at sea, the Arena grew five phases
surprise.body: Since you sailed on Sunday, the Arena Battlegrounds remake finished five full build phases with green builds: competitive balance and discipline matchups (Phase 25), the complete main menu and settings (26), Free Duel with custom rules and practice (27), the Arcade Tournament with championship brackets (28), and the Story Campaign, Fracture of the Five Seals (29). Phase 30, player progression with XP, achievements, spell unlocks, and cosmetics, got partway in on Tuesday before the build tool ran out of usage, and it picks up again with a top-up or the next weekly reset. Back home in Tallahassee it is a foggy, mild morning around 73°F, warming to about 80°F this afternoon with only an 11% chance of rain, and the sun sets at 5:46 PM. Welcome back, Zae.

source.label: Arena build logs from the team; Open-Meteo forecast for Tallahassee, Nov 5
